# linux_package (Resource)

Installs a package with the package manager of the host: apt, dnf, yum, zypper, apk or pacman. Destroying the resource removes the package only if this resource installed it: a package that was already installed is left in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linux_package" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx"
}

# Pin a version, as the package manager shows it.
resource "linux_package" "jq" {
  name    = "jq"
  version = "1.6-2.1+deb12u1"
}

# Several packages.
resource "linux_package" "tools" {
  for_each = toset(["curl", "git", "htop"])
  name     = each.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the package.

### Optional

- `version` (String) Version to install, exactly as the package manager shows it (see `installed_version`), such as `1.6-2.1+deb12u1` with apt. Without it, any installed version is accepted. Not supported with pacman.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Name of the package.
- `installed_version` (String) Installed version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the name of the package.
terraform import linux_package.nginx nginx
```
